sloka: यदि माम् सम्स्पृशेद् रामः सकृदद्य लभेत वा ।यमक्षयमनुप्राप्ता द्रक्ष्यन्ति न हि मानवाः ॥२-६४-६५॥
transliteration: yadi mām samspṛśed rāmaḥ sakṛdadya labheta vā ।yamakṣayamanuprāptā drakṣyanti na hi mānavāḥ ॥2-64-65॥

translations.english: Before I die, will Rama touch me once or will he come to me? After reaching the abode of Yama men cannot see their relations.
